text: A tiny floating island with a vegetable bed and a bunny-ish creature. Says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Day 2, 10 coins. Tapping the tomatoes.
Sowed and watered by tapping the bed. The bunny is called a Momo, it's now standing in the bed. Prompt says Tap a Momo. Doing that.
Got the Momo selected — panel says Momo, Free time, Assign. Tutorial points to a pencil to pick tiles it looks after. The tutorial box overlaps the panel text, a bit messy.

Momo now 'Working at Farm', farm tile marked 1. A wall of text popped up about building farm/mine/lumberyard/lab on empty tiles. Island seems to have 4 tiles. Pressing Got it, then I'll want to build something on the empty tile.
Momo is auto-farming now, coins ticking up to 30, +16/min. Mailbox has a red dot and the Momo has a letter bubble. Opening Mailbox.
Cute letter from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. Charming! Tapping 'Let's research it'.

Research tree: Farm/Lumber/Mine/Smelting/Power/Games tabs. Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20 coins, and says 'Build a research lab'. So I need a lab on an empty tile. Tapping that button to see if it takes me there.
Tapped empty tile: build menu. Farm 10 coins; Lumberyard and Research lab open at Lv2, Mine at Lv3. I'm Lv1 75/90 so almost there. Building a second farm meanwhile.
Reached Lv2! Second farm is built and planted already. New letter 'Maybe we could water less often'. Reading it, then I'll build a research lab on another empty tile.
Accepted Watering efficiency too. Build menu now: Lumberyard 80, Research lab 40. I have 96. Building the lab so I can do the Momo's research ideas.
Lab is being built. New hint: I can buy sea next to the island for 25 — expand the island! Nice. Dismissing, then tapping the dashed sea spot twice.
Bought the sea tile — island grew with a new grassy corner, satisfying. Lab is making flasks by itself (+1 bubble). Second farm looks ripe and nobody's picking it. Checking Hire for a second Momo.
Hired a second Momo called Mochi. Going to give Mochi the lab and the second farm with the pencil.
Mochi now looks after lab + farm 2 (numbered 1 and 2 = route order I guess). Research has 3/3 flasks — Start research on Field expansion!
Accepted Bigger harvests proposal. 115 coins, +96/min, Lv3 so Mine should be open. Tapping the empty grass in the middle-bottom to build.
Mine costs 120 + Wood 10 (wood in red, I have none). So lumberyard first (80). Building lumberyard here. Nice clear chain: farm -> wood -> mine.
Field expansion finished (Lv1/5). Watering efficiency has 5/5 flasks ready. Lumberyard built, with Fell/Replant actions. Picking Watering efficiency.
Started Watering efficiency (1m30s). Tree on the lumberyard got felled — a Momo is standing there. Nobody is assigned to the lumberyard though, I think. Tapping Replant myself.
215 coins. Hire now costs 100. Hiring a third Momo for the lumberyard so I can get wood for the mine.
New Momo is Pomu. Trying the big 'Assign' button this time instead of the pencil, to see what's different.

Assign + tap lumberyard says 'Another Momo works here'. Huh — so someone already took the lumberyard? I didn't assign anyone. Slightly confusing; Pomu is still idle. Let me check Status to see wood and who does what.
Status shows a goal! Village -> City: Land 5/9, Momo 3/3 done, Research levels 1/3, Value produced 588/1.5K. Great, now I have a target. Buying land is the fastest lever — 223 coins, sea tile is 35.
Bought another tile, Lv4 now, island is an L shape. Research has a red dot — starting the next one for the City goal.
Started Bigger harvests (2 min). Mine's wood cost is no longer red, so the lumberyard made enough wood. Building a Mine on the new tile!
Mine is built (cute cave with a cart). Mochi wrote a letter proposing a Tree nursery — accepting. Then I'll try digging the mine myself.
A Momo went to the mine on its own and is digging. 348 coins. Going to buy another land tile (dashed one bottom-right) for the City goal.
Bought a 45-coin tile, island keeps stretching toward the bottom of the screen — it's starting to go off-screen, I wonder if I can scroll. Checking City progress in Status.
City progress: Land 7/9, Research 2/3, Value 1K/1.5K. Close! Need 2 more land. Trying to drag the view up to see more sea tiles.
Dragging scrolls the view, good. No dashed sea tile is shown now though. Trying to tap the sea right beside the island.
Bought the 55 tile, island is a big square-ish shape now, and Bigger harvests finished. One more land should hit 9/9. Trying the sea at lower-left.
That spot didn't offer land — not sure which sea spots are buyable; the dashed hint only shows sometimes. Out of time soon. Overall: cozy, clear, I want to see the City.
